name: w-monet-path-en2
prompt: Impressionist oil painting in the manner of Monet's brushwork and color. A gently curving garden path lined with blooming roses and hollyhocks, dappled sunlight through the leaves, a distant woman with a parasol seen from behind, soft pale blue and pink clouds. Short broken brushstrokes, colors luminous even in shadow.

name: w-art-nouveau-portrait
prompt: Art Nouveau portrait in profile of a young woman, framed by whiplash curves of irises and ginkgo leaves, an ornamental halo, muted gold, olive and dusty rose, flat decorative patterns, lithograph texture, no visible hands.

name: w-renoir-bench-en
prompt: Impressionist oil painting with Renoir's soft touch. A wooden garden bench holding a straw hat and a loose bunch of wildflowers, sunlight filtering through leaves onto the seat and petals, blurred greenery and white blossoms behind.

name: w-fauvist-harbor
prompt: Fauvist painting of a harbor at sunset, boats and water in arbitrary saturated oranges, greens and violets, simplified forms, thick brushwork, no people.

name: w-iris-en
prompt: Post-Impressionist oil painting in Van Gogh's manner. A cluster of blue-violet irises, petals built from thick color and clear contours, yellow centers, swirling blue-green background, upright leaves, close-up composition, visible impasto.

name: w-pomegranate-en
prompt: Baroque still life oil painting. A carved silver plate with three pomegranates, one cut open to reveal deep red seeds, strong light from the left, sharp highlights on the silver, red fruit against dark brown shadows, a few dry leaves on the table.

name: snow-fox-en
prompt: Wildlife photograph. A red fox standing on a snowy forest clearing, low winter morning sun behind it, rim light on its fur, breath visible as white vapor, snow dusted on its coat, blurred pine forest and pale blue snow slope behind, shallow depth of field.

name: w-symbolist-garden
prompt: Symbolist painting. A veiled figure at the edge of a moonlit pool, surrounded by irises and floating points of light, deep violet, teal and silver, dreamlike atmosphere, soft edges, face turned away.

name: w-pissarro-street-en
prompt: Impressionist oil painting in Pissarro's manner. An early morning Paris street, wet cobblestones reflecting the sky, scattered carriages and pedestrians, Haussmann buildings on both sides, grey-blue sky.
